distribution.narrative: Liao et al. (2022) described Scolytoplatypus skyliuae from Jiangxi and Fujian, with the holotype from Huanggang Mountain and paratypes from Wuyishan.

host_note: Fujian paratypes carry a direct Castanopsis fargesii host label; this is promoted as confirmed host evidence.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus skyliuae Liao, Lai & Beaver, 2022.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytoplatypus skyliuae
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Scolytoplatypus skyliuae Liao, Lai & Beaver was described as a new species in 2022 and maps directly to stable VSN_5444.
